description:
Hushfacebook v0.11.1 targets Facebook 582.0.0.50.54 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release.

Settings share clearer focus and disabled states in every theme. Editors keep rejected drafts, and Downloads and diagnostic export show their current result. This source update also adds bounded push and Reel-sidebar diagnostics and fixes the shared save limit.

This release has 88 patches. Built by GitHub Actions from commit 1c60b4b3df0a, with build provenance attested. The patches weren't applied to a Facebook APK in CI.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a bundle of Facebook 582.0.0.50.54, build 475417104, or its 32-bit build 475417036. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
